body:
I guess your underlying problem was to reformat the whole content.hits (not just hits.map) and have them passed to the regular "item" template (instead of having to use allItems template).

The current template behavior is too complex as an API. Most people just want to reorder/reformat the whole hits or some hits. Header/footer transformData are complexifying the API.

Fixing what you are talking about in 1.x might be a little tricky to get right, in particular in term of documentation since this would be more of a workaround a feature that does not exists than a real feature.
